title: Banana den Forno
hookLine: Global-inspired banana den forno with 5 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Banana den Forno
steps.instructionTemplate: Peal the bananas and boil them together with the cinnamon, vanilla extract, sugar and water for about 20 minutes. Bake the bananas in the oven at 275°F for 10 minutes. Incorporate {m53441_1}, {m53441_2}, {m53441_3}, and {m53441_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure banana first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Bake Banana den Forno & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready. Incorporate {m53441_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Serve with favorite ice cream. Let Banana den Forno cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 4 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Banana den Forno to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 4 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 38 mins!
